final: WITH circuit_races AS (SELECT circuitId, AVG(CAST(round AS FLOAT)) as avg_round, COUNT(*) as race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) as total FROM circuit_races), threshold AS (SELECT MIN(race_count) as min_threshold FROM (SELECT race_count FROM circuit_races ORDER BY race_count DESC LIMIT 10)) SELECT c.circuitId, c.avg_round, c.race_count, CAST(c.race_count AS FLOAT) / t.total as ratio FROM circuit_races c CROSS JOIN total_count t WHERE c.race_count >= (SELECT min_threshold FROM threshold) ORDER BY ratio DESC
